description: Questline clustering oracle for the WPL pilot: which quests belong to which arc, wiki storyline parts, and excluded arcs. Used to evaluate discovery/clustering; not a pipeline draft payload.

storyline_parts.title: The first battle for Andorhal
storyline_parts.summary: Three-way war at Andorhal; faction entry quests plus shared Scourge-clearing beats including Scholomancer/Araj (Scholomance foreshadowing, not Gahrron's arc).

storyline_parts.title: The uneasy calm
storyline_parts.summary: Faction-split mid-campaign at Andorhal after the first battle; ends with Combat Training before players leave for restoration content.

storyline_parts.title: The mending of the Plaguelands
storyline_parts.summary: Mender's Stead restoration arc with Argent Crusade and Cenarion Circle (pilot-excluded as a major card; thin, non-seed).

storyline_parts.title: Living in the Plaguelands
storyline_parts.summary: Northridge lumber mill / local reconstruction side content (pilot-excluded as a major card).

storyline_parts.title: Hearthglen
storyline_parts.summary: Tirion Fordring audience and Fordring legacy investigation at reclaimed Hearthglen.

storyline_parts.title: The renewed plague
storyline_parts.summary: Del Gahrron / Gahrron's Withering cauldron investigation; now an included major card (Part 6).

storyline_parts.title: The battle resumes
storyline_parts.summary: Return to Andorhal for the faction finale; Forsaken win, Alliance loses (Alas, Andorhal / The Reckoning).

included_arcs.title: Andorhal Campaign (Horde)
included_arcs.significance: The zone's most important Horde arc: Sylvanas' post-Wrath push to claim Andorhal, culminating in a Forsaken victory and The Reckoning punishing Koltira for mercy toward Thassarian.
included_arcs.notes: Card chain_refs are the 11-quest Part 1->2 spine (entry, Scourge First, Victory For Now, the uneasy-calm chain through Combat Training). The Part 7 'battle resumes' finale (The Battle Resumes -> Supporting the Troops -> Lindsay Ravensun -> Ace in the Hole / The Farmers' Militia -> Andorhal, Once and For All -> The Reckoning) is overflow. Faction quest pages use (Horde) disambiguation; the shared Part 1 beats and the shared Part 7 openers (The Battle Resumes!, Ashes to Ashes) are shared with the Alliance arc.

included_arcs.title: Andorhal Campaign (Alliance)
included_arcs.significance: Mirrored Alliance arc; finale (Alas, Andorhal) ends in Forsaken victory and Alliance failure to hold the city.
included_arcs.notes: Card chain_refs are the 12-quest Part 1->2 spine (entry, Scourge First, The Endless Flow, Victory For Now, the uneasy-calm chain through Combat Training). The Part 7 'battle resumes' finale (The Battle Resumes -> Supporting the Troops -> The Depravity of the Forsaken -> Val'kyr Incursion / Brother Against Brother -> Aradne -> Alas, Andorhal) is overflow. No Horde Endless Flow variant exists in the crawl, so the Alliance spine is one quest longer than the Horde spine.

included_arcs.title: Tirion Fordring's Legacy
included_arcs.significance: Part 5: Tirion audience and Fordring legacy at reclaimed Hearthglen.
included_arcs.notes: Mainline is the Taelan Fordring legacy chain. The It's About Time! -> Drudges... *Sigh* pair is a side chain off the An Audience with the Highlord breadcrumb, so it is overflow, not mainline.

included_arcs.title: The Renewed Plague
included_arcs.significance: Part 6: the renewed plague at Gahrron's Withering; Mender's Stead, Argent Crusade and Cenarion forces purge the last cauldron and confront the cultists of Professor Krastinov.
included_arcs.notes: Promoted from excluded to a major card (run review 2026-06). Mainline is the Gahrron's Withering cauldron purge through Students of Krastinov. The Long Trip Home -> Memories from a Lost Past side chain and the Zen'Kiki and the Cultists bridge (shared with the Part 3 Mender's content) are overflow. Distinct from the excluded Part 3 Mender's Stead arc.

excluded_arcs.title: Northridge Lumber Mill / Redpine gnoll conflict
excluded_arcs.significance: Part 4 local reconstruction - not pilot-significant as a major card.

excluded_arcs.title: The Mender's Stead / Healing the Plaguelands
excluded_arcs.significance: Part 3 restoration arc - a short, non-seed-mentioned chain that does not clear the structural inclusion bar (run review 2026-06).

andorhal_entry_breadcrumbs.description: Optional zone-entry quests parallel to Hero's Call / Warchief's Command (faction-specific (Alliance)/(Horde) quest pages).
